name: Soft ripe persimmon
summary: Soft ripe persimmon from the orchards on Mimosa Pass.
origin: Hồng chín mềm, listed with the wind-dried, dried, and pressed persimmons.
howToEat: Buy it with the other persimmon sweets from the orchards.
where: Orchards at the end of Mimosa Pass, along Trần Hưng Đạo and Khe Sanh.
seoDescription: Soft ripe persimmon from the orchards on Mimosa Pass.
